title: Hemispherical shell with an 18° hole under alternating point loads
source: MacNeal and Harder, 'A proposed standard set of problems to test finite element accuracy', Finite Elements in Analysis and Design 1 (1985) 3–20, Fig. 9 (p. 9), Table 5(b) (p. 11): 0.0940 (lower bound 0.0924 from their [7])

quantities.quantity: displacement under the outward load along the load
quantities.reason: MacNeal and Harder grade an element A within 2% of the theoretical value on this prescribed coarse mesh (p. 14); the source quotes 0.0940 with a lower bound 0.0924 from their ref. [7]; on the 8 × 8 mesh it is 1.86% low (0.092253), and refinement moves it monotonically towards the reference (16 × 16 1.25%, 32 × 32 0.78%, 64 × 64 0.54% low; 4 × 4 is 7.6% low)

quantities.quantity: displacement along y under the inward load (the load acts along −y)
quantities.reason: the symmetric counterpart of u (the same magnitude, along −y), graded by the same source figure (MacNeal and Harder, p. 14; 0.0940, lower bound 0.0924 from their ref. [7])
